versos.texto_bv: Efraim é uma novilha domada, que ama trilhar o grão, mas eu poupei o seu belo pescoço. Farei Efraim puxar a carga: Judá lavrará, e Jacó gradeará para si.
versos.traducao_literal: E Efraim [é] novilha domada, que ama trilhar; e eu passei sobre a bondade do seu pescoço; farei cavalgar Efraim, lavrará Judá, gradeará para si Jacó.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0031): אַרְכִּ֤יב (hiphil de רָכַב) significa 'farei cavalgar', não 'farei puxar a carga'. A imagem é de montar/cavalgar, não de puxar. A KJV verte corretamente 'I will make Ephraim to ride'. — evidência: אַרְכִּ֤יב אֶפְרַ֨יִם; morfologia HVhi1cs; KJV: 'I will make Ephraim to ride'.

kjv.texto: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.

vizinhos.10: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
vizinhos.12: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the Lord, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

web.texto: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh; so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on Ephraim. Judah will plow. Jacob will break his clods.

vizinhos.10: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the nations will be gathered against them, when they are bound to their two transgressions.
vizinhos.12: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek Yahweh, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.

versos.texto_bv: Um tumulto se levantará entre o seu povo, e todas as suas fortalezas serão devastadas, como a devastação de Salmã contra Bete-Arbel, no dia da batalha, quando a mãe foi despedaçada com os filhos.
versos.traducao_literal: E levantar-se-á tumulto entre o teu povo, e todas as tuas fortalezas serão devastadas, como a devastação de Salmã [contra] Bete-Arbel, no dia de guerra; mãe sobre filhos foi despedaçada.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0031): עַל בָּנִ֖ים significa 'sobre os filhos', não 'com os filhos'. A imagem é de mãe despedaçada sobre (em cima de) seus filhos, não junto com eles. A KJV verte corretamente 'upon her children'. — evidência: אֵ֥ם עַל בָּנִ֖ים רֻטָּֽשָׁה; morfologia HR/ HNcmpa; KJV: 'the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children'.

kjv.texto: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth–arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.

vizinhos.13: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
vizinhos.15: So shall Beth–el do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.

web.texto: Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle. The mother was dashed in pieces with her children.

vizinhos.13: You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.
vizinhos.15: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness. At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.

versos.texto_bv: O rei de Samaria será destruído, como um graveto sobre a face das águas.
versos.traducao_literal: Destruído [é] Samaria, o seu rei; como um graveto sobre a face das águas.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0031): קֶצֶף (Strong 7110) significa 'espuma, escuma', não 'graveto'. A imagem profética é de algo que rapidamente desaparece (espuma na água), não de um graveto que flutua. A KJV verte corretamente 'foam'. — evidência: כְּקֶ֖צֶף עַל פְּנֵ֥י מָֽיִם; morfologia HR/Ncmsa; KJV: 'as the foam upon the water'.

kjv.texto: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.

vizinhos.6: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
vizinhos.8: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.

web.texto: Samaria and her king float away, like a twig on the water.

vizinhos.6: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel.
vizinhos.8: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars. They will tell the mountains, “Cover us!” and the hills, “Fall on us!”
